items.item:
6. Each action of M09.actions accepted and changing its record — a Customer's
   restriction among them — writes exactly one entry, in its transaction.
   Shows A14-1. [witness: verification:registry_a14_accepted_change_writes_one_entry_in_transaction]
statements:
```text
entry e exists <=> accepted action a in M09.actions, with changed(a) or a an
erasure of old entries, and e written in the transaction of a   -- A14-1
e.outcome = accepted   -- A14-2
```

verdicts.item:

statements:

verdicts.why: The executed test runs every audited M09 action through a helper that requires exactly one new accepted entry, including Customer restriction and audit erasure. Faults at both the record write and audit-entry insertion are detected as transaction failures and the assertions require that neither the record change nor an entry persists; the successful retry requires both.
